notes.title: New feature: View pet attributes
notes.content: Clicking on the pet icon will allow you to view the pet's attributes.

notes.title: You can directly recruit a mage teammate.
notes.content: The prerequisite task for recruiting mages has been removed. Now, you can directly recruit mage teammates in the Cliff Mountain area.

notes.title: Quick upgrade
notes.content: Increased the experience points of monsters, reduced the number of items required for tasks, and accelerated the player's leveling up speed.
